description.value: The Black Bear Pub is a neighborhood pub on Doumont Road in Nanaimo with a seasonal full-service patio overlooking Brannen Lake. Under new management, it serves classic pub fare with daily specials alongside regular community events including meat draws, karaoke, and music trivia nights. It is a 19+ adults-only establishment that can accommodate large group reservations in semi-private spaces.
